name: mmm-intelligence-local
description: Local exploratory Marketing Mix Modeling with synthetic-data workflows and explicit scientific limits.

interface.longDescription: Generate synthetic data, inspect quality, fit exploratory marketing models, compare compatible evaluations, simulate conditional allocations and export reports. Runs locally with a separately installed Python environment. Does not modify advertising campaigns. The dashboard opens locally without a login; the separate HTTP MCP endpoint retains authentication.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create a synthetic marketing dataset and explain its model's diagnostics and limitations.

prompts: Create a synthetic dataset, check its quality and fit an exploratory marketing model.
Compare two models of the same dataset on their common test dates and explain their limitations.
Simulate a different budget allocation without changing real campaigns.

publication.release_notes: Local authoring package with the existing MCP server and an exploratory analysis workflow. Not submitted to the public directory.
